title: Materials.
officialText: Concrete or grout shall have a 28-day specified compressive strength (f'c) of not less than 2,500 psi (17.24 MPa), except in micropiles and caisson piles where the minimum compressive strength shall be 4,000 psi (27 580 kPa). Where concrete is placed through a funnel hopper at the top of the pile, the concrete mix shall be designed and proportioned so as to produce a cohesive workable mix having a slump of not less than 4 inches (102 mm) and not more than 6 inches (152 mm). Where concrete or grout is to be pumped, the mix design shall be such that material produced is suitable for pumping.
